texts.zh: 对于在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。没能抓到一个活口使得这次调查极具挑战。不过幸运的是，他们还是留给我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]丰富的材料用以破解它们的语言，我们现在将其识别为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，如果我们乐意的话还能和对方进行沟通。此外，我们还能够研究它们在自己舰船上使用的科技，这能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
texts.en: We have concluded our study of the vessel we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. The absence of a living crew made our investigation challenging. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their ship's technology, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

texts.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their technology, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] to uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.
